tponder.ponder.alloyer_building.text_1: The Alloyer is very similar to The Melter
tponder.ponder.alloyer_building.text_2: This is a specialized device for making alloys
tponder.ponder.alloyer_building.text_3: Place containers on sides of Alloyer
tponder.ponder.alloyer_building.text_5: Then it will automatically make alloys
tponder.ponder.casting.text_1: Scorched casting containers must be used with casts
tponder.ponder.fluid_cannon_using.text_1: Fluid Cannon can shoot fluid and different fluids have different effects
tponder.ponder.fluid_cannon_using.text_2: Check the Tinker's Guide for specific fluid effects
tponder.ponder.foundry_building.text_1: The Foundry is very similar to The Smeltery
tponder.ponder.foundry_building.text_2: But it uses scorched blocks and its edges must be filled
tponder.ponder.foundry_building.text_3: The outer wall can also be extended upwards by up to 63 blocks
tponder.ponder.foundry_building.text_4:
The Foundry has unique features:
It will produce some by-products when smelting
And it can't be used to make alloys
tponder.ponder.heater_using.text_1: The Heater can burn solid fuel to provide a temperature of 800℃
tponder.ponder.melter_building.text_1: The Melter is your first device as a tinker
tponder.ponder.melter_building.text_2: It requires a heater for heat
tponder.ponder.melter_building.text_3: The Heater needs fuel to work
tponder.ponder.melter_building.text_4: Or you can use fuel tank
tponder.ponder.melter_building.text_5: Also, don’t forget to add fuel such as Lava
tponder.ponder.sand_casting.text_1: Sand Cast can only be used once
tponder.ponder.sand_casting.text_2: Right Click with item to make shape
tponder.ponder.smeltery_building.text_1: The bottom of the Smelter is a rectangle composed of seared blocks
tponder.ponder.smeltery_building.text_2: The maximum size of a rectangle is 14x14 blocks
tponder.ponder.smeltery_building.text_3: You need place a controller outside the second layer
tponder.ponder.smeltery_building.text_4: You need to place at least one tank for fuel
tponder.ponder.smeltery_building.text_5: To cast, you need plate a drain
tponder.ponder.smeltery_building.text_6: The second layer should be closed
tponder.ponder.smeltery_building.text_8: The outer wall can be extended upwards by up to 63 blocks
tponder.ponder.smeltery_building.text_9: Don’t forget to add fuel such as Lava
tponder.ponder.smeltery_using.text_1: Right Click to open the GUI of the Smeltery
tponder.ponder.smeltery_using.text_2: You can put items in the GUI to start melting
tponder.ponder.smeltery_using.text_3: And next, some functional blocks are introduced
tponder.ponder.smeltery_using.text_4: The Chute can input and output items to and from the Smeltery
tponder.ponder.smeltery_using.text_5: The Drain and Duct can input and output fluids to and from the Smeltery
tponder.ponder.smeltery_using.text_6: The Duct has a GUI with a slot that can filter fluids
tponder.ponder.smeltery_using.text_7: Try put a Can with Molten Gold
tponder.ponder.tag.smeltery.description: Tinker's components used to smelting and casting
tponder.ponder.tank.text_1: Tinker's fluid containers roughly divided into 4 categories
tponder.ponder.tank.text_2: Gauge: holds 48 ingots of fluid, retains liquid when broken
tponder.ponder.tank.text_3: Tank: holds 48 ingots of fluid, retains liquid when broken
tponder.ponder.tank.text_4: Casting Tank: interacts with items, retains liquid when broken
tponder.ponder.tank.text_5: Proxy Tank: interacts with items, agents item inside
